title: The Quiet Parish
author: Ulyana Lockridge
blurb: Hazel Montrose, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the trial begins.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
